roast.intro: Bet you can't hold your breath for sixty seconds. Prove me wrong.
roast.inhale: Breathe in... no, a real breath, not that NPC sip. Hold.
roast.safety: If you get dizzy, breathe. I'm roasting you, not ending you.
roast.lvl0: {t1}. Stamina of a phone on two percent.
roast.lvl1: You're making a face right now. Yeah, that one. Everyone can see it.
roast.lvl1b: Halfway. Your lungs are texting your nose, you up?
roast.up2: {t3}?! Okay, who's holding the phone for you?
roast.lvl2: Your cheeks look like a chipmunk that just saw the wifi bill.
roast.boss: Final boss. Breathe now and your ancestors are disappointed.
roast.exhale: Breathe out. Max aura. Fine, I'll admit it. You ate.
roast.cta: You cheated, didn't you? Comment your time.

coach.intro: Alright, NPC. Let's see if those lungs are real or just decoration.
coach.inhale: Big breath in. Bigger. That's it? Fine. Hold.
coach.safety: Dizzy? Breathe. Even I'm not that toxic.
coach.lvl0: I've seen a paper bag with better lung capacity.
coach.up1: {t2}. Don't let it go to your head.
coach.lvl1: Stop blinking so much. It's using oxygen.
coach.lvl1b: Halfway. You're shaking like a chihuahua in the snow.
coach.lvl2: Your face is the colour of a red flag right now.
coach.boss: Final boss. Breathe now and you're an NPC forever.
coach.exhale: Breathe out. Max aura. I'm not crying, you're crying.
coach.cta: Comment your time. And don't lie, I'll know.

brainrot.intro: Skibidi breath check. Sixty seconds or you lose all your aura.
brainrot.inhale: Inhale like it's the last slice of pizza... and hold.
brainrot.safety: Seeing stars? Breathe. Stars are free, aura is not.
brainrot.lvl0: {n1} detected. Your diaphragm is on airplane mode.
brainrot.lvl1: Somewhere, a fish is watching you and laughing.
brainrot.lvl1b: Halfway. Your nose is filing for unemployment.
brainrot.up2: {t3}! Your lungs are mogging your personality.
brainrot.lvl2: Don't think about yawning. You just thought about yawning.
brainrot.boss: Final boss. Ohio level difficulty. Lock in!
brainrot.exhale: Breathe out! Max aura. GTA six could never.
brainrot.cta: Comment your time. Liars lose aura.
